info.title: Summary AI — Agentic Reading, Summarizing & Research API
info.description: Open-source agentic AI reading, summarizing, and research platform patterned after smry.ai. Powered by FastAPI, LangGraph multi-agent orchestration, Hybrid Vector/BM25 RAG with exact passage offsets, Edge-TTS neural Karaoke audio, and FastMCP.

post.summary: Recompute Passage Embeddings Across Library (Deterministic or Local Ollama /api/embed)
post.description: Recomputes and persists passage embeddings. When provider='ollama', high-dimensional vectors are stored in PassageChunk.embedding_json. Note that hybrid search currently relies on 256-dimensional deterministic embeddings for zero-latency ranking and falls back when query and stored dimensions differ; Ollama reindexing does not affect search ranking until query-time Ollama embedding matches the stored dimension.
